shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/medical/recreation, power/pipes/climate, stairs/ladders/elevators, opt-in vertical threats, caravan/trade/launch world integration, one-colony UI, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. Soft compat via detection + reflection; foreign types never in signatures.
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid mineable rock, thick-roofed, 12C. Animal policy conservative; pen animals never cross. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- ALL vertical links IMMORTAL; removal via Remove gizmo or architect deconstruct. VERIFIED.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x), grand staircase 2x2 (0.6x, quality-scaled), elevator (0.35x, two-hop rides). Climb = 90t x type x quality x slider. Minifiable, collapse together. Landing platforms footprint+1, air-reversion exempt.
- T9 vertical utility links: conduit (Power/Electricity/CompABPowerBridge), water pipe (DBH patch-gated). utilityOnly excluded from pawn routing at NearestUsableStairs; per-def bridge flags.

## Sky surface model (round-10 final)
- AB_OpenAir / AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop. COVERED-BELOW rule, 8-neighbor re-sync, 2000t sweep. Mountain cap in vanilla fog material clones (overlap-free tiling, two runtime queues); mined floors in rock edge color. Self-heal: retry + ReconcileRooftops.

## See-below renderer (round-13, VERIFIED)
- Cloned section materials at runtime queues; Watergen excluded + lower.waterInfo.SetTextures() per frame = real vanilla water shader from above; mask = fog + baseDim only; one-way mirror dynamic pass.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified)
- Logistics: haul/fetch/demand-pull/export-pin/carried-delivery; column-aware stuff picker. Needs: rest/food across column; RECREATION across column (round 15: JobGiver_GetJoy.TryGiveJob postfix at LOW Harmony priority - Common Sense and all other joy patches get first refusal, we act only on final null; virtual re-scan at stairwell exits, 600t per-pawn cooldown, stairs trip + natural re-roll on arrival). Medical rescue three ways; capture. One-colony UI. Power 10t, pipes/climate 250t; ABPendingOrders replay.

## T8 threats + pocket NPC movement (VERIFIED rounds 12-14)
- Diversion at execution; infestations -> basement (relaxed finder + locOverride), drop raids -> sky. Pocket incident redirect at TryExecute (DeepDrill exempt, ABIncidentLevelPolicy opt-in). Pocket NPC scan: hostiles (never insects/vehicles) descend and join assaults; friendlies with exit duties (vanilla set + RegisterExitDuty) get exit lords on the surface.

## World integration (done)
- Tile identity; column wealth (setting ON); cross-level caravans (trim + stairs + pending join); column trade; settlement-loss warning + native pocket destruction. Guard world.

## T11 mod compatibility (rounds 14-15, Docs/CompatMatrix.md)
- Library: 1471 mods (~897 active) triaged. EXPLICIT: VEF pipes, DBH (+vertical pipe), Vehicle Framework (type-check excludes vehicles from all routing), Hospitality (Relax never exit; TakeWoundedGuest + vanilla set; RegisterExitDuty), Common Sense (decompile-audited: no JobGiver_Work patch; joy seam shared via LOW priority), Giddy-Up, Reverse Commands, Fluffy Animal Tab, Declutter.
- OK by audit: Hauler's Dream (stat patches, orthogonal), Smarter Construction (coherent under virtual swaps), Romance on the Rim (same-map dates; couples converge via beds; API date-summons candidate), Allow Tool/PUAH-class, RJW + addons.
- INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded (ACTIVE in user's real list - flagged).
- Watch: Perspective Shift, airship traders, Real Ruins (inactive), gravships (tile follows, untested).

## T12 open API (Docs/API.md)
- ABApi v1: level/column queries, GetStairsToward/TrySendPawnToward (full transfer + lord handling), events LevelCreated/LevelRemoved/PawnTransferred (fail-open raisers), RegisterExitDuty.
- XML: ABStairsExtension = public surface for third-party vertical links (full lifecycle); ABIncidentLevelPolicy.allowOnPocketLevels consumed by the redirect.

## Performance architecture
- Plain-bool guards; AnySkyLevels gate; stairs memo. Recurring: weather 150t, pipes/climate 250t, power 10t, sweep 2000t, NPC scan 250t pocket-only. Joy migration costs only on null joy scans behind a 600t cooldown. Zero recurring cost with no levels.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Rendering: rare floating rim cells; sky projectile dim; tall sprite clip at edges; no below water depth shading; mined-floor hard tint edges.
- Systems: bill radius vs stairs delivery; couples as singles in beds alert; RC + stuff picker direct links only; restaurants per-level; doctor pile-on window; sweep-cadence wall edits.
- T8: mounted Giddy-Up raiders never descend; basement insects stay; incidents never target pocket levels directly (API opt-out).
- World: caravan items surface-only; animals/prisoners not listed cross-level; purchases drop at surface; transporter loading surface-only; gravships untested.
- Dates (RotR) happen when partners co-located; no cross-level date summons yet.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T10 + threats + world integration DONE/verified. T11 compat (incl. hauling/romance audit + cross-level recreation) + T12 API: IMPLEMENTED, pending smoke test (joy migration, API events, redirect).
- Next: T5 publishing prep. Backlog: VEF per-net shafts via API, caravan items/animals cross-level, RotR date summons, watch-list verifications.

## Status
Round-15: hauling/romance compat audit done (Common Sense decompiled), cross-level recreation implemented at the shared joy seam. Compiling. T5 publishing prep next.
